verdict.rationale: GitBook documents an official MCP server. Clients such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor can use it to create and configure sites, open change requests, draft and edit pages, and restructure docs. Separate MCP servers are also offered for published docs, and a probe confirms the official MCP documentation page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server in use, and setup/auth details in the evidence.
